state.description: Guild channels, threads (types 10/11/12) and DMs (type 1), keyed by padded channel id.
Guilds (servers), keyed by padded guild id.
Messages, keyed `<channel>:<message>` (padded) so a channel's history is one ordered prefix scan.
Single row `service`: fallback identity, snowflake generator state, scan bound and optional response byte budget (default 900000).
enforce_nonce de-duplication rows, keyed `<channel>:<UTF-8 hex of nonce>`; live for 300 s of virtual time.
One row per user reaction, keyed `<channel>:<message>:<emojiKey>:<user>`; emojiKey is `u`+UTF-8 hex or `c`+padded emoji id.
Roles, keyed `<guild>:<role>` (padded); `@everyone` has the guild's id.
Accounts, keyed by the 20-digit padded user id.

operations.description: Get a guild channel, thread or DM the caller can view.
Get one guild member.
List guild members in ascending user id (`limit` 1-1000, default 1; `after`).
Get a guild the caller is a member of, with roles and emojis (`with_counts` adds approximate counts).
List the guild's non-archived threads the caller can view, plus the caller's thread memberships.
List a guild's channels (not threads), sorted by position.
Send a message (content, embeds, reply via message_reference, nonce + enforce_nonce de-duplication, allowed_mentions).
Delete a message (own, or any with MANAGE_MESSAGES in a guild channel) and its reactions.
Edit the caller's own message (content, embeds, SUPPRESS_EMBEDS flag, allowed_mentions).
Get one message.
List a channel's messages newest first (one of `around`/`before`/`after`; `limit` 1-100, default 50).
Add the caller's reaction (unicode emoji or `name:id` guild emoji). `changed` is false when it already existed.
List users who reacted with an emoji, ascending id (`after`, `limit` 1-100 default 25, `type` 0 normal / 1 burst).
Remove the caller's reaction (`@me`) or another user's (MANAGE_MESSAGES). `changed` is false when there was none.
List a guild's roles, sorted by position.
Create a thread without a starter message (type 12 private by default; 11 public; 10 in announcement channels).
Start a public thread from a message (the thread id equals the message id).
Open (or return the existing) DM channel with a user.
Get the current user (`@me`) or a user by id.
List the current user's DM channels.
List the guilds the current user is a member of (ascending id, `before`/`after`/`limit` 1-200, `with_counts`). `server_time` is the world's virtual time.
